model.title: Grasslands Grazing Act of 2025
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. John Barrasso (R-WY)

summary.text: The bill would amend federal land management law to ensure that ranchers with grazing agreements on national grasslands receive the same treatment and protections as ranchers who graze on other federally managed lands.
